##### Project general facts

Golf Vista Heights is a refined residential development in Dubai Sports City, designed as a modern architectural statement surrounded by serene golf course landscapes. Rising across B+G+14 floors, the building presents a balanced contemporary design with clean lines and elegant proportions that enhance its connection to nature. The project comprises 209 units, including studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom residences, each carefully planned to maximise space, natural light, and panoramic golf views through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and private terraces.

The development offers a lifestyle defined by tranquility, comfort, and a strong connection to nature within a family-friendly community. Residents enjoy uninterrupted views of lush green fairways, creating a peaceful environment that feels both private and open at the same time. The surrounding area of Dubai Sports City enhances the living experience with access to sports facilities, leisure options, and everyday conveniences, making it a well-balanced destination for both relaxation and active urban living.

Inside, Golf Vista Heights features elegant contemporary interiors designed with soft tones, natural elements, and abundant daylight that enhance the sense of space and calm. Bedrooms are thoughtfully designed with built-in wardrobes and access to beautifully appointed ensuite bathrooms, offering a refined residential experience. Kitchens come fully equipped with Teka appliances, combining functionality with modern design. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their homes while enjoying a high-quality foundation of premium finishes and sophisticated detailing.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a vibrant and dynamic community that embodies the spirit of sports, leisure, and active living. Nestled within the heart of Dubai, this meticulously planned district is designed to cater to the needs of athletes, sports enthusiasts, and those seeking a balanced and energetic lifestyle.

Dubai Sports City is home to world-class sporting facilities, including the Dubai International Stadium and the Els Club golf course, providing residents and visitors with opportunities to engage in various sports and recreational activities. Whether it's cricket, football, golf, or tennis, the community offers a range of facilities to nurture both professional and amateur athletes.

The community's central location ensures easy access to Dubai's major attractions, business districts, and educational institutions. In addition, Dubai Sports City hosts numerous entertainment venues, dining options, and shopping destinations, offering a well-rounded and dynamic lifestyle.
